Name: Sebastian No Escape - Black Save (Yandere Route)
Author: putaohuqi
Description:
[b]Content warnings !![/b]
Obsessive/possessive themes, stalking implications, coercive language, threatening tone, missing/disappearance themes, and injury/death/passout references.

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Full heart-event route (Intro, 2H, 4H, 6H, 7H, 8H, 10H + dating ask)
[*]Dialogue overhaul with festival-specific lines
[*]Rival jealousy progression content
[*]Post-death and post-2AM exhaustion/passout aftermath scenes with variations
[/list]
﻿﻿[b]No-spoiler event triggers[/b]
[list]
[*]Intro: Mountain, 6:00 PM–10:00 PM
[*]2H: Mountain, 7:00 PM–9:00 PM
[*]4H: Sebastian’s Room, 5:00 PM–7:50 PM
[*]6H: Bus Stop, 9:00 PM–2:00 AM (rain or snow)
[*]7H: Carpenter, 10:00 AM–5:00 PM
[*]8H: Beach, 12:00 AM–2:00 AM (sunny)
[*]8H Dating Ask: Farm, 6:00 AM–11:50 PM
[*]10H: FarmHouse, 8:00 PM–2:00 AM
[*]﻿Archive Event: Sebastian’s Room, 8:00 PM–2:00 AM (late-route optional event)
[*]Rival Event Stage 1: Pierre's General Store, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM
[*]Rival Event Stage 2: Town, 9:00 AM–10:00 PM
[*]Rival Event Stage 3: Mountain, 6:00 PM–2:00 AM
[/list]Some events require prior route progression/flags, so meeting time/location alone may not trigger them.

[b]Bug Reports / Support[/b]
If you run into a bug, please report it in the [b]Bugs[/b] tab with:
[list]
[*]Your [b]SMAPI log[/b] (upload here: [url]https://smapi.io/log[/url])
[*]Mod version
[*]Your game version + platform (Windows/Mac/Linux)
[*]Exact steps to reproduce the issue
[*]Where/when it happened (location, time, weather, heart level, event trigger)
[/list]Without a SMAPI log, I usually can’t diagnose the issue accurately.

[color=#ff4d4d][size=5][b]MINOR SPOILERS - POST 7H[/b][/size][/color]
[spoiler] With Generic Mod Config Menu installed, you can toggle [b]Permanent Disappearance[/b]:
[list]
[*][b]ON[/b]: rivals/Robin stay gone after the 7H point
[*][b]OFF[/b]: disappearance is temporary and they return to normal schedules [/spoiler]
[/list]
The portraits are from Baechu's Portrait mod: ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3218]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3218[/url]
